content.title: Validate: configurable branch name for agt init
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

Validate the implementation done by library-developer. Run quality gates, check test coverage on changed code, verify spec compliance.

Specifically verify:
1. agt init without --branch produces identical behavior to current (backward compat)
2. agt init --branch testing creates branch _testing and dir .testing/
3. Normalization handles edge cases (_testing, __foo, etc.)
4. config.json includes branch field after custom init
5. push and pull work with custom branch names
6. Invalid branch names produce clear errors
7. Multiple inits with different branches create separate worktrees
8. Gitignore entries are correct per branch
9. Existing tests still pass unchanged
